verdict.rationale: Workspace export is a fair question for a workspace and knowledge-management tool, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a workspace export feature, let alone one that preserves comments, attachments and audit trails. The REST API's ability to read pages and comments is only a developer building block for building an export, not the export capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know that exporting my workspace preserves full history—comments, attachments, and audit trails—not just task titles
